title: 형사 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 형사 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Methods and Procedures for Inspection and Copying)
(1) After a judgment becomes final and conclusive, a person may inspect or copy judgments, etc. by applying to the court that pronounced the judgment, or may inspect and print them through the court's website: Provided, That where there are multiple defendants, inspection and copying may be conducted only after the judgments concerning all defendants have become final and conclusive. <Amended on December 4, 2018>
(2) A person applying for inspection or copying under paragraph (1), or inspecting or printing documents through the court's website, shall pay the fees prescribed by the Rules on Inspection and Copying of Trial Records. <Amended on December 4, 2018>
